rules.instruction: When the description indicates that optional work may be triggered by an event after the main flow has completed: Model the triggered work as a separate process, rather than as a detached start-to-end chain in the same process.
rules.situation: the description indicates that optional work may be triggered by an event after the main flow has completed

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins when a participant performs an action: Model the process trigger with a start event, then model the described action as an activity after that event; do not use the start event alone to represent the action.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant performs an action that initiates the process

rules.instruction: When the description states a process trigger followed by a subsequent activity: Connect the start event to the first activity with an outgoing sequence flow, preserving the stated execution order.
rules.situation: the description states a process trigger followed by a subsequent activity

rules.instruction: When the description says that an ongoing activity continues until a stated condition occurs, and then states an outcome that follows: Model waiting for that condition with an intermediate catch event, then continue the flow to the stated outcome.
rules.situation: the description says that an ongoing activity continues until a stated condition occurs, and then states an outcome that follows

rules.instruction: When the description identifies the object or information entity acted on by an activity: Label the corresponding BPMN activity using that stated entity rather than substituting a related but distinct one.
rules.situation: the description identifies the object or information entity acted on by an activity

rules.instruction: When the description states that the same process can be initiated through mutually exclusive channels: Model an exclusive gateway that branches to a separate activity for each channel.
rules.situation: the description states that the same process can be initiated through mutually exclusive channels
